provenance.author: Vincent Russo
provenance.method: exact: no two-qubit stabilizer state is parallel to |CS>, decided in Q(i) over the 60 states enumerated from the parametrization

compute.hardware: Apple silicon laptop, one core; about 15 s for the certificate

notes: Settles chi(|CS>) = 2 with the two-term witness. |CS> is not a stabilizer state: its support is all of F_2^2 but the phase i^(x1 x2) is not a Z_4-valued quadratic form with even cross terms (the cross term is odd), and the certificate decides this as the rank-1 case of its exact pair search: every two-qubit stabilizer state is written down from the verifier's parametrization as a vector over Z[i] (60 states, checked against 2^2 (2+1)(4+1) and pairwise distinct up to phase), and none has a vanishing component off |CS>. Exact throughout; no floating-point margin stands under the bound. Controls: |++> is reported as rank 1, and the pair {|++>, CZ|++>} is among the 15 pairs of two-qubit stabilizer states that span |CS>.
